class.name: RTGI
class.brief_description: Real-time GPU BVH ray-traced global illumination node using OpenGL 4.3 compute shaders.
class.description: Computes physically-based indirect diffuse global illumination (color bleeding, emissive mesh lighting, sky irradiance, and multi-bounce light transport) against scene [MeshInstance]s, [MultiMeshInstance]s, [CSGShape]s, and animated skinned [Skeleton] meshes using a two-level GPU BVH (TLAS/BLAS) and an incremental 3D [Texture3D] irradiance volume cache. Denoises demodulated irradiance using checkerboard reconstruction, YCoCg variance-clipped temporal accumulation, and edge-aware A-Trous spatial filtering before multiplying by surface diffuse albedo and bilaterally upsampling onto the active viewport.

method.name: apply_quality_preset
method.description: Applies a scalability preset ([constant PRESET_LOW], [constant PRESET_MEDIUM], [constant PRESET_HIGH], or [constant PRESET_ULTRA]) across resolution, ray count, bounce depth, 3D volume density, denoising, and simplification settings.

method.name: get_gi_albedo_texture
method.description: Returns the RGBA16F receiver diffuse albedo [Texture] (RGB = [code]albedo * (1.0 - metallic)[/code], A = receiver mask).

method.name: get_gi_texture
method.description: Returns the RGBA16F demodulated indirect irradiance [Texture] (RGB = linear HDR irradiance, A = camera-to-surface distance, negative for sky/invalid).

method.name: get_gi_volume_texture
method.description: Returns the real-time camera-centered RGBA16F 3D [Texture3D] irradiance cache updated on the GPU.

method.name: mark_geometry_dirty
method.description: Invalidates cached BLAS structures so acceleration structures rebuild on the next snapshot update.

method.name: reset_history
method.description: Clears temporal accumulation and 3D volume history. Call after camera cuts or teleports.
